crossRefs.note: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”
Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in…
Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much…
My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and…

translations.web: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
translations.bsb: Then a spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body bristled.
translations.kjv: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
translations.asv: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair of my flesh stood up.
